harnessFindings.impact: Expired-code fixture remained effectively future-dated; verification returned 200; invalid fixture excluded from service-failure verdict
harnessFindings.reproduction: On the guarded UTC JDBC connection, bind 2000-01-02T03:04:05 with setObject(LocalDateTime); read via getTimestamp and Hibernate LocalDateTimeJavaType.wrap: 2000-01-02T12:04:05
harnessFindings.resolution: Explicit setTimestamp at a fixed past second; read effective application timestamp and require it to be in the past before HTTP

harnessFindings.impact: Overly strict target-time assertion stopped before verification HTTP; no service-failure evidence
harnessFindings.reproduction: Initial Timestamp correction required effective timestamp <= an unrounded target as well as expiration; assertion failed. Exact original timestamp was not retained, so the detailed rounding cause remains unproven
harnessFindings.resolution: Fixed past whole second; persist diagnostic before checking the actual required condition effective timestamp < application now

harnessFindings.impact: PowerShell UTF-8 BOM in the review JSON caused StreamReadException; P0 13 PASS remained valid and P1 had not started
harnessFindings.reproduction: Read a PowerShell Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 JSON through Files.readString then Jackson readTree(String)
harnessFindings.resolution: Read JSON bytes so Jackson recognizes the UTF-8 BOM; reuse recorded P0 approval and execute P1 only
